objective_summary: Decide whether the Valdena Civic Health Office can prototype a day-ahead poor-air warning method now on public hourly air-quality data (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04), and whether its own station, traffic and daily district clinic-count data (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) cover the live warning model at the needed grain. The output also has to list which data cannot be used (patient-level records, expired vendor feed) and which red flags must be cleared before profiling.

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly concentrations of NO2 and/or PM2.5 (and ideally PM10) per monitoring station in Italy, covering the prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 for the client's own stations. Station location and pollutant unit must be recoverable.
internal_queries: hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5
city air monitoring station data feed production 2024-2025
ARIA stazioni inquinanti orari (internal jargon for air-station export)
pollutant concentration hourly export requested from city station
external_data_hints: Regional environmental protection agency (ARPA) or national environment agency open-data portal for Italian monitoring stations, hourly NO2/PM2.5 for the northern-Italy region near the client's assumed location, covering 2004-03 to 2005-04. Check that the 2004-2005 series exists at hourly grain and is not only daily or annual aggregates.

EEA Air Quality e-Reporting or Air Quality Download Service for Italian stations: confirm hourly coverage for 2004-2005 before relying on it; the trap is that station sets and validation status change over time and the series may start later than 2004.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly grain (or finer) for at least NO2 or PM2.5 across the full prototype window with no multi-day gaps in the chosen station
Station identifier and coordinates available so the station can be matched to a traffic count and a weather point
Concentration unit (e.g. µg/m3) stated in the source and consistent across the window
Licence or open-data terms of the source read at source and recorded; for prototyping only unless Legal signs off production use
Production window (2024-2025) covered by the client's own station export, not by the public source alone
likely_pitfalls: Station codes and locations change between years, breaking joins
Unit or averaging-period changes (hourly vs daily, µg/m3 vs other) across the series
Validation status of recent data may be provisional
Register has no public air-quality source; any public series is a human-sourced link, not a registered approval
Client's station data is still requested; the prototype cannot depend on it

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly vehicle traffic counts or flow near each air-monitoring station, covering the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 at the city's own station locations.
internal_queries: spire veicoli traffico orario (internal jargon for traffic loop counts)
traffic loop data requested from municipality
external_data_hints: Municipal or regional open-data portal publishing hourly traffic counts (loops, cameras or counters) for the client's city, 2024-2025. Check that sensors are within a few hundred metres of an air station; the trap is that traffic sensors are often on arterial roads not near the monitor.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly counts for the production window with no multi-week gaps at the sensors used
Sensors can be mapped to the air-monitoring stations by distance (documented threshold)
Vehicle counts are aggregated flows, not person-identifying
Licence of the traffic source read and recorded
likely_pitfalls: No registered traffic source exists; the production need is currently unserved by any register entry
Counts may be vehicle-class specific or directional; define a single aggregation
Sensor outages create gaps that look like low traffic
Sensors may be moved or replaced over the two years

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly air temperature and relative humidity at or near the client's assumed location, covering both prototype and production windows.
internal_queries: weather observations feed for air model
acceptance_criteria: Hourly grain for temperature for both windows (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31)
Relative humidity: the register's Open-Meteo variable list (temperature_2m, shortwave_radiation) does not include humidity; record this as a coverage gap, do not request a changed variable list
Coordinates for the assumed location recorded as an assumption in decisions.md
AtmosData Pro feed: agreement expired 2025-12-31 and API key revoked 2026-01-01; record as an expired-agreement finding and do not use for production
Open-Meteo use is approved for prototyping and production under the register terms; confirm the terms page before production use
likely_pitfalls: Register default coordinates (45.4642, 9.19) are Milan, while the brief says the default is Lisbon; confirm which location is intended
Reanalysis (Open-Meteo) is modelled, not station-observed; differs from local station readings
Timezone: query is set to UTC; align to local time with the air data
Humidity gap means the weather covariate set is incomplete for the model

need_plans.interpretation: Daily counts of respiratory clinic visits by district for the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Aggregated counts only; no individual-level rows.
internal_queries: respiratory clinic visits daily by district
acceptance_criteria: Daily grain by district for every day in 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (zero days explicit)
Only aggregated counts; any patient-level or per-visit row is a scope and privacy finding and is excluded
Diagnosis grouping for 'respiratory' defined by the clinic and documented
District codes join to a district reference
likely_pitfalls: Counts may be dropped for days with clinic closures, so zeros are ambiguous
Coding of respiratory diagnoses may change over time
Small district counts risk disclosure; apply suppression rules
Clinic data is not yet confirmed as delivered by the clinic in aggregated form

need_plans.interpretation: Patient-level clinic visit records. OUT OF SCOPE by brief: individual patient records must not be searched for, opened, downloaded or profiled. Planned only so that any such catalog entry is reported as a scope and privacy finding.
acceptance_criteria: No patient-level record is opened, sampled or profiled
Any catalog entry with one row per patient visit is reported as a scope and privacy finding and excluded from all needs
likely_pitfalls: Catalog entries may be named generically (visit log, admissions extract) while holding one row per patient
Even a sample of rows would breach the brief

need_plans.interpretation: National yearly statistics linking deaths to PM2.5 exposure for Italy, annual grain, covering the prototype and production years as far as available (context only).
internal_queries: health impact air pollution yearly national context
external_data_hints: National statistics office (Istat) or national health institute / EEA health-impact indicator tables for Italy: annual attributable deaths due to PM2.5, covering 2004-2005 and 2024-2025. The trap is that modelled attributable-death estimates from different studies are not comparable and may not cover 2004-2005.
acceptance_criteria: Annual grain for Italy
Coverage of the prototype year(s) and the production years stated; if a year is missing, record it as a gap
Method and source of the estimate stated (modelled vs observed); licence of the source read at source
likely_pitfalls: Attributable-death estimates are modelled and differ by method
Year coverage may not match the windows
Context only; not a model input

open_questions: Which city does the client's station network cover? The brief says no source names the city; the register's Open-Meteo default is Milan coordinates while the brief refers to a Lisbon default. Confirm the location to record in decisions.md.
When will the city's own air-quality station export (2024-2025) and the traffic counts be delivered, and in what format?
Is there a clinic-side confirmation that visit data can be delivered as daily district counts only, with zero days explicit?
Renewal status of the AtmosData Pro contract (expired 2025-12-31): is a renewal expected, and does Procurement treat it as needed for production?
Does Legal accept the public air-quality and traffic sources found by the human for prototyping, and separately for production?
Is relative humidity required from a source other than Open-Meteo, given the register variable list excludes it?
